profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer | React, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, C#, .NET Core | Slack Ping Magnet
profile.summary:
I’m a Frontend Engineer with 6+ years of experience building fast, scalable, and accessible web applications using React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript tooling. I specialize in component-driven architecture, clean state management, and developer experience — from scalable UI libraries to testing strategies and documentation systems.

I thrive in collaborative Agile teams, enjoy mentoring other developers, and care deeply about writing maintainable code that aligns with business goals. Always learning, always iterating.
